Two things about the eleven forty block. If Tom asks for a number you do not have, say so and follow up the same day. He has told me that twice. And if lunch runs long, you will lose the site tour, not the credit block. Print nothing.

Guessing is. Second, if we run out of time, I will stay for the credit block and drop the targets block. Tell your director that. And if the weather closes the airport, we will do the whole thing on a call, at the same hour.
